test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. To think that a computer would one day replace a book is indeed unthinkable and far fetched.

B. The thoughts and ideas contained in a book are immortal like Tulsidas’ Ram Charitra Manas, Ved Vyas’ Mahabharata, The Bible and many other religious and literary works like Shakespeare’s plays etc.

C. On the other hand a computer is but a machine, that at best can visually display the contents of a specific book.

D. A good book in the words of John Milton “is the precious lifeblood of a master spirit, embalmed and treasured up to a purpose to a life beyond life."
solution:
The correct answer is **'DBCA'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Sentence **D **is the first sentence as it tells the definition of a good book in the words of 'John Milton'**.** 
 
• Sentence **B **would come in the second line as it further elaborates the points stated in the first sentence i.e. '“A good book is the precious lifeblood of a master spirit, embalmed and treasured up to a purpose to a life beyond life."'
 
• Sentence **C **would come next as this sentence is comparing computers with books.
 
• Sentence **A **would be the last sentence as it concludes the comparison between book and computer.

Hence, the correct answer is **'DBCA'.**
